**Tessera Notes 0.1.3 makes deleting a page for good hold on every device, makes exports work in the desktop app, and opens large workspaces faster.** It's the first release the desktop app can install by itself: 0.1.2 finds it with **Check for updates…** and asks before installing it. Your data and settings carry over unchanged. Upgrading is recommended.

### Highlights

- **Pages deleted for good stay deleted everywhere.**
  - A page you delete permanently on one device no longer lingers on another device that was offline at the time: that device drops its copy the next time it syncs.
  - Relations that pointed to a deleted page are cleaned up by whichever device opens the workspace next, even when the tab that deleted the page closed right away. Workspaces that already have such leftovers are cleaned up the same way.
- **Exports work in the desktop app.** Exporting pages, the JSON backup in Settings and a database's CSV export open your system's save dialog and tell you where the file went; **Save as…** saves another copy. PDF export prints through the app. Before, these did nothing in the desktop app.
- **Large workspaces open faster.** Opening a workspace with 5,000 imported notes blocked the app for up to 470 ms; now the longest pause is about 200 ms. Large documents are merged in the background, and they're kept compact after a big import.
- **The graph pans smoothly without a graphics card.** On a computer without a usable GPU, dragging a graph of thousands of pages now follows the pointer (frames about 33 ms instead of 200–270 ms), and the graph redraws once you let go.
- **Escape closes one thing at a time.** Pressing Escape while a menu or popover is still closing no longer closes the dialog behind it as well.
- **Callout titles keep their line breaks** when you export to markdown and import it again.

Also: the Docker image's arm64 build now runs natively instead of under emulation, where it could hang for an hour; four security alerts in build and documentation dependencies are fixed; and contributors on Windows get instructions for cloning into deep folders.

### Closed issues

- [#7](https://github.com/femboypuppy/Tessera-Notes/issues/7) Relation cleanup can leave dangling IDs if the tab closes right after a permanent delete
- [#8](https://github.com/femboypuppy/Tessera-Notes/issues/8) Escape during a popover's exit animation needs a second press
- [#10](https://github.com/femboypuppy/Tessera-Notes/issues/10) Orphaned local docs after a permanent delete on another device
- [#11](https://github.com/femboypuppy/Tessera-Notes/issues/11) Windows: long fixture paths need `core.longpaths` to clone into deep folders
- [#30](https://github.com/femboypuppy/Tessera-Notes/issues/30) Desktop: export downloads and printing in the webview
- [#33](https://github.com/femboypuppy/Tessera-Notes/issues/33) CI: nightly performance and load jobs
- [#35](https://github.com/femboypuppy/Tessera-Notes/issues/35) Drop Firefox's COOP preference when upgrading to Playwright 1.64
- [#55](https://github.com/femboypuppy/Tessera-Notes/issues/55) Labeler and Dependabot: the first runs
- [#56](https://github.com/femboypuppy/Tessera-Notes/issues/56) Docker: the arm64 build can hang under emulation until the job's 60-minute timeout
- [#66](https://github.com/femboypuppy/Tessera-Notes/issues/66) Opening a large workspace blocks the main thread while its workspace doc loads
- [#87](https://github.com/femboypuppy/Tessera-Notes/issues/87) Markdown: a line break in a callout's title moves the rest out of the title
- [#96](https://github.com/femboypuppy/Tessera-Notes/issues/96) Graph: panning 10,000 nodes without a GPU takes 200 ms per frame (p95)

### Upgrade

- **Desktop 0.1.2:** choose **Check for updates…** (Help menu; the Tessera menu on macOS), or wait for the app to offer 0.1.3, and install it; the app restarts on 0.1.3.
- **Desktop 0.1.0 or 0.1.1:** download the file for your system below and install it over your version. From then on the app updates itself.
- **Docker:** `docker pull ghcr.io/femboypuppy/tessera:0.1.3`, then recreate the container with the same volume; your data stays. `latest` points to 0.1.3 too.
- **In the browser:** once your server runs 0.1.3, reload Tessera.
- **Plugins:** nothing changed for plugins; plugins made for 0.1.2 keep working.

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS (Apple silicon) | `Tessera_0.1.3_aarch64.dmg` |
| macOS (Intel) | `Tessera_0.1.3_x64.dmg` |
| Windows | `Tessera_0.1.3_x64-setup.exe` or `Tessera_0.1.3_x64_en-US.msi` |
| Linux | `Tessera_0.1.3_amd64.AppImage`, `.deb` or `.rpm` |

`SHA256SUMS.txt` lists every file's checksum. The desktop apps aren't signed with a developer certificate yet, so the first launch asks for your permission: on macOS, choose **Open Anyway** in System Settings → Privacy & Security; on Windows, **More info** → **Run anyway**.
